title: Hawaii aquaculture loan program.
bodyText: There is established the Hawaii aquaculture loan program to be administered by the board of agriculture and biosecurity.
bodyHtml: §219-3  Hawaii aquaculture loan program.  There is established the Hawaii aquaculture loan program to be administered by the board of agriculture and biosecurity. [L 1971, c 181, pt of §1; ree L 1977, c 212, pt of §2; am L 2025, c 236, §18]
